book.soulland.page.alchemy:
7. ALCHEMY STATION

Craft an Alchemy Station from two Spirit Iron Ingots, a Soul Crystal Shard and a Soul Essence, then right click it to open the brewing screen.
Cultivation Pill: Spirit Dew, Spirit Ember, 1 Soul Essence.
Swift Pill: Spirit Moss, Spirit Dew, 1 Soul Essence.
Foundation Pill: Spirit Ember, Spirit Moss, 2 Soul Essence.
book.soulland.page.beasts:
6. SOUL BEAST AND BOSSES

Monsters are soul beasts. Their name carries their age and element, so you always know what you are hunting.
Bosses of this world are far stronger than vanilla: Elder Guardian, Wither, Warden, and the ENDER DRAGON as the final boss.
book.soulland.page.closing:
KEEP CULTIVATING

"No martial soul is rubbish; only rubbish spirit masters are." - Grandmaster Yu Xiaogang

Train, hunt as a team and never give up. The road to God starts at level 1.
book.soulland.page.commands:
8. COMMANDS

/soulinfo - your cultivation status
/soul language - open the language screen
/martialsoul info - details about your martial soul
/martialsoul reroll - replace your martial soul (Creative only)
/sect choose <name> - join a sect
/cultivation set <player> <level> - admin
book.soulland.page.foundation:
4. FOUNDATION

Meditation builds your foundation from 0 to 100. The foundation sets your breakthrough chance: at 20 you may attempt the ceremony, at 100 the breakthrough always succeeds.
A failed ceremony costs 25 foundation points, so meditate again before you try once more.

The Foundation Pill adds 25 points at once. Reach level %s and the god gate opens: the sky thunders over you.
book.soulland.page.level:
2. SPIRIT POWER LEVEL

Levels run from 1 to 120. Kill soul beasts (monsters) to gain cultivation XP.
Every rank boundary is a gate: you cannot pass it without absorbing a new spirit ring, holding a full meditation and spending one Soul Essence.
book.soulland.page.martial_soul:
1. MARTIAL SOUL (WU HUN)

The first time you join the world you pick the language, then the Awakening Ceremony opens. You choose your martial soul yourself; there is no draw, no lottery.
That choice is yours for life, and only Creative mode can replace it with /martialsoul reroll.
book.soulland.page.multiplayer:
9. MULTIPLAYER

Every system runs on the server: ceremony, levels, rings, skills and alchemy are saved per player.
Invite friends, build a team (the Pagoda support soul helps a lot) and take the bosses down together.
book.soulland.page.ranks.goal:
THE FINAL GOAL

The ladder ends at God, starting from level %s. Reaching it raises the tribulation flag: the sky thunders and lightning strikes. The full tribulation system arrives in v1.6, so v1.2B only marks the threshold.

Absorb the gold 1,000,000 year ring, defeat the Ender Dragon, and your name becomes legend on the Douluo Continent.
book.soulland.page.ranks.note: Every rank boundary is a gate: absorb a new spirit ring and meditate fully before you climb.
book.soulland.page.ranks.title: CULTIVATION RANK LADDER
book.soulland.page.rings:
3. SPIRIT RING

Soul beasts drop rings according to their age: 100 years, 1,000 years, 10,000 years, 100,000 years and the gold tier of 1,000,000 years.
The gold tier falls from the Ender Dragon and sometimes from the Warden.

RISK: every ring has a safe level. Absorbing above it is dangerous: the server rolls your chance to fail, and a failure destroys the ring and hits you with backlash. Hold Shift to confirm a risky absorption.

MUTATION: every successful absorption has a 1% chance to mutate the ring. Its effective age rises one grade and your permanent stat bonus grows.
book.soulland.page.skills:
5. MARTIAL SOUL SKILLS

Every martial soul has 4 skills. They open at spirit ring 1, 3, 5 and 7.
Skills cost spirit power (the blue bar in the HUD) and have their own cooldown.
Press R, G, F and V to use them, or open the Soul Card with J to rearrange the loadout.
book.soulland.page.welcome:
WELCOME TO THE DOULUO CONTINENT

You have awakened your Martial Soul! This book explains every system of the Soul Land world: cultivation, spirit rings, skills, soul beasts, alchemy and the road to God.

Read it once, then keep it in your inventory. Every page follows the language you chose.
book.soulland.title: Soul Land Guide
guide.soulland.section.1:
1. Hunt soul beasts. The name carries the age and the element, for example "1,000 Years (Fire)" or "10,000 Years (Ice)".
2. Absorb the spirit rings they drop.
3. Rebuild your loadout in the Soul Card (J), tab SKILLS. Five slots, any order.
4. Chain skills to raise damage: every link adds +8% for 4 seconds, up to +40%.
5. Pick your target by element. Win +25% damage, lose -15%.
guide.soulland.section.2:
The first time you join the world you pick the language, then the Awakening Ceremony opens.
You choose your martial soul yourself. There is no draw and no lottery.

The natural order:
1. Kill soul beasts for cultivation XP.
2. Absorb the spirit rings they drop.
3. Confirm risky absorptions with Shift.
4. Build your skill loadout in the Soul Card, tab SKILLS.
5. Run the breakthrough ceremony to climb a rank.
guide.soulland.section.3:
Every martial soul has 4 skills that open at spirit ring 1, 3, 5 and 7.

Five button slots (R G F V Z) can be filled freely. Open the Soul Card with J, go to the SKILLS tab, then click a skill to place it.
Click a filled slot to empty it and fall back to the default order.

Each skill has its own effect shape: ball, line, cone, ring, disc, pillar or storm.
guide.soulland.section.4:
Spirit rings come from soul beasts according to their age: 100 years, 1,000 years, 10,000 years, 100,000 years and the gold tier of 1,000,000 years.
The gold tier falls from the Ender Dragon and sometimes from the Warden.

RISK: every ring has a safe level. Absorbing above that level can fail: the ring shatters and you take backlash. Hold Shift to confirm the risky absorption.
MUTATION: a successful absorption has a 1% chance to mutate the ring, raising its effective age one grade and giving a permanent stat bonus.

Press X to burst your rings: the whole energy is released at once, radius and damage follow the number of rings.
guide.soulland.section.5:
Cultivation runs from level 1 to 120 and fourteen ranks, from Spirit Scholar to God.
Every rank boundary is a gate.

A gate cannot be crossed with XP alone. Run the breakthrough ceremony: hold C, meditate 3 seconds, and spend 1 Soul Essence.
Your foundation decides the outcome. It builds while you meditate: at 20 you may attempt the ceremony, at 100 you always succeed. A failed ceremony costs 25 foundation points.

Plain meditation (hold C) restores spirit power and adds XP. Moving breaks the meditation.
guide.soulland.section.6:
A sect gives a passive bonus that always applies and never hurts. Pick one through the SECT tab on the Soul Card, or click a sect medallion directly.

Tang Sect: +20% cultivation XP.
Shrek Sect: +12% damage.
Star Luo Sect: +10% movement speed and +10% max health.
Seven Treasure Sect: +20% max health and +25% healing.
guide.soulland.section.7:
Soul chain: every skill that lands adds one link. The chain lasts 4 seconds, each link adds 8% damage to the next skill, up to 5 links (+40%).

Element counter: a soul beast name carries its element. +25% damage when your element wins, -15% when it loses.

Blood burn (B): trade 25 HP for 30 Spirit Power, 8 seconds of +50% damage. Not allowed below 35 HP.

Bosses: Elder Guardian 120 HP, Wither 600 HP, Warden 800 HP, Ender Dragon 1000 HP as the final boss.
guide.soulland.tip.1: Every number on this screen is read from your own state, so it always matches the world.
guide.soulland.tip.2: Your martial soul never changes by itself. Only Creative mode can replace it.
guide.soulland.tip.3: Skill loadouts are free. Rearrange them as often as you like.
guide.soulland.tip.4: Absorbing above the safe level is a gamble. The tooltip always shows your current risk.
guide.soulland.tip.5: The breakthrough ceremony needs 3 seconds of still meditation and 1 Soul Essence. Moving restarts the timer.
guide.soulland.tip.6: You can switch sects at any time, so try the one that fits how you play.
guide.soulland.tip.7: The soul chain is the cheapest way to raise damage. Line your skills up in order.

soul.soulland.thunder_spear.name: Thunder Spear
soul.soulland.thunder_spear.description: A spear that is only visible when the lightning inside it is.
soul.soulland.spirit_sword.name: Spirit Sword
soul.soulland.iron_anchor.name: Iron Anchor
soul.soulland.iron_anchor.description: The guild's oldest anchor, dropped by sailors who never came back up.
soul.soulland.bronze_mirror.name: Bronze Mirror
soul.soulland.blue_silver_emperor.name: Blue Silver Emperor
soul.soulland.blue_silver_emperor.descri: The grass grown old enough to rule: ten thousand years of quiet green authority.
soul.soulland.iron_body.name: Iron Body
soul.soulland.iron_body.description: A body that learned to be metal, and pays for it in weight and cold.
soul.soulland.bone_shell.name: Bone Shell
soul.soulland.bone_shell.description: Bone grown outward into a shell, layer after layer, year after year.
soul.soulland.stone_skin.name: Stone Skin
soul.soulland.stone_skin.description: Ordinary skin that hardened after ten years of standing in the rain.
soul.soulland.flesh_regrowth.name: Flesh Regrowth
soul.soulland.flesh_regrowth.description: Wound tissue that closes faster than it should, at the price of memory.
soul.soulland.flame_body.name: Flame Body
soul.soulland.flame_body.description: A body that burns from the inside and answers heat with heat.
soul.soulland.spirit_veins.name: Spirit Veins
soul.soulland.soul_mirror.name: Soul Mirror
soul.soulland.spirit_lamp.name: Spirit Lamp
soul.soulland.spirit_lamp.description: A lamp that burns without oil and lights whatever the holder is thinking about.
soul.soulland.soul_forge.name: Soul Forge
soul.soulland.soul_forge.description: A forge that heats soul instead of metal, and shapes what comes out of it.
soul.soulland.star_array.name: Star Array
soul.soulland.star_array.description: Seven points of light and the space between them, arranged just so.
soul.soulland.demon_eye.name: Demon Eye
soul.soulland.demon_eye.description: An eye that never blinks, because it has nothing to be afraid of.
soul.soulland.ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal
soul.soulland.ancient_seal.description: A seal older than the sect that stamped it, and it still answers to the hand.
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_fang.name: Fire Fang
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_fang.descript: A single burning bite that chars the target from the inside.
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_scales.name: Scale Wall
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_scales.descri: Golden scales harden into a shell that soaks the next blows.
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_sun.name: Sun Flare
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_sun.descripti: A stored sunburst erupts around you and throws the enemy back.
skill.soulland.gold_dragon_ascension.des: The wyrm unwinds and dives: a burning nova that flings everything away.
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_graze.name: Abyssal Graze
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_graze.descri: Claws of the abyss open a wound that bleeds shadow instead of blood.
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_void.name: Void Pull
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_void.descrip: The abyss drags every nearby enemy toward your claws.
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_gaze.name: Starless Gaze
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_gaze.descrip: A stare that unseats the soul: the target is marked and left reeling.
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_abyss.name: Abyssal Verdict
skill.soulland.demon_dragon_abyss.descri: The dragon dives through the floor and erupts beneath the field.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_frost.name: Frost Rend
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_hail.name: Hail Prison
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_hail.descripti: A ring of ice locks every enemy in place.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_chain.name: Frozen Chain
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_chain.descript: Ice lashes out from your grip into three enemies at once.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_winter.name: Deep Winter
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_winter.descrip: Winter closes in: a nova of ice that slows everything it touches.
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_breath.name: Ember Breath
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_breath.descri: A short breath of living flame scorches everything in front of you.
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_wing.name: Wing of Cinders
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_wing.descript: Cinder wings beat the air and scatter burning motes across the field.
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_scale.descrip: Your skin hardens into cooled lava: resistance and a shield of heat.
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_caldera.name: Caldera
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_caldera.descr: The dragon opens its jaws and a column of fire erupts from the ground.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_lance.name: Glacier Lance
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_lance.descript: A spear of clear ice forms in your hand and pierces one target.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_veil.name: Frost Veil
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_shatter.name: Shatter
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_frostfall.name: Frostfall
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_frostfall.desc: The sky itself falls: a nova of ice that locks the ground in place.
skill.soulland.thunder_elephant_stomp.de: One heavy footfall shakes the ground and jolts a single target.
skill.soulland.thunder_elephant_storm.de: The herd runs with you: a nova of thunder that throws the field aside.
skill.soulland.golden_ant_bite.descripti: Tiny jaws find the gap in your enemy's guard.
skill.soulland.golden_ant_acid.name: Acid Spray
skill.soulland.golden_ant_acid.descripti: A mist of acid weakens everything it touches.
skill.soulland.golden_ant_dig.name: Tunnel
skill.soulland.golden_ant_dig.descriptio: You sink into the ground and burst up under three enemies.
skill.soulland.golden_ant_swarm.name: Swarm March
skill.soulland.golden_ant_swarm.descript: A wave of golden ants floods the field and carries it off.
skill.soulland.giant_ape_smash.name: Mountain Smash
skill.soulland.giant_ape_smash.descripti: Both fists come down on one enemy with the weight of a hill.
skill.soulland.giant_ape_roar.descriptio: The roar shakes the courage out of every enemy in range.
skill.soulland.giant_ape_throw.name: Stone Throw
skill.soulland.giant_ape_throw.descripti: A boulder goes through three enemies in a straight line.
skill.soulland.giant_ape_tremor.name: Tremor
skill.soulland.giant_ape_tremor.descript: The ape pounds the earth and the whole plain shakes.
skill.soulland.manatee_tether.name: Iron Tether
skill.soulland.manatee_tether.descriptio: A rope of water catches one enemy and refuses to let go.
skill.soulland.manatee_drag.name: Undertow
skill.soulland.manatee_drag.description: The water beneath the field pulls every enemy toward you.
skill.soulland.manatee_venom.name: Salt Venom
skill.soulland.manatee_venom.description: Salt water and old blood: poison that spreads through the wound.
skill.soulland.manatee_deep.name: Deep Below
skill.soulland.manatee_deep.description: Something enormous rises under the water and drags the field down.
skill.soulland.moth_dust.name: Luminous Dust
skill.soulland.moth_dust.description: A cloud of bright dust stings the eyes of one enemy.
skill.soulland.moth_wingbeat.name: Wingbeat
skill.soulland.moth_dazzle.name: Dazzle
skill.soulland.moth_dazzle.description: A thousand wings reflect light until the target loses its nerve.
skill.soulland.moth_swarm.name: Night of Wings
skill.soulland.moth_swarm.description: The moth empties the air: a pale nova that blinds and slows everything.
skill.soulland.phoenix_ember.name: Ember Peck
skill.soulland.phoenix_rebirth.name: Rebirth
skill.soulland.phoenix_rebirth.descripti: Burned away and restored: resistance and a shield of warm light.
skill.soulland.phoenix_talon.name: Talon Dive
skill.soulland.phoenix_reignite.name: Reignition
skill.soulland.phoenix_reignite.descript: The bird rises out of its own ashes in a ring of fire.
skill.soulland.bss_pierce.description: The spear finds the seam in a single thrust.
skill.soulland.bss_bind.name: Grass Bind
skill.soulland.bss_bind.description: Blue silver vines wrap the target and hold it still.
skill.soulland.bss_venom.name: Silver Venom
skill.soulland.bss_venom.description: The spearhead leaks a toxin that keeps working after the thrust.
skill.soulland.bss_empire.name: Emperor's Reach
skill.soulland.bss_empire.description: Every blade of grass in the field points the same way, and strikes together.
skill.soulland.seven_kill_mark.name: First Notch
skill.soulland.seven_kill_mark.descripti: The blade opens a small wound and counts it as one.
skill.soulland.seven_kill_drain.name: Blood Ledger
skill.soulland.seven_kill_drain.descript: The sword drinks what it opens and hands part of it back to you.
skill.soulland.seven_kill_notch.name: Seventh Notch
skill.soulland.seven_kill_notch.descript: The blade jumps between enemies, leaving a notch on each.
skill.soulland.seven_kill_finish.name: Final Count
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_down.name: Overhead Blow
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_down.descrip: The hammer comes down on one target with a clang that hurts.
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_sweep.name: Wide Swing
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_sweep.descri: A slow arc that catches everyone standing in front of you.
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_anchor.name: Anchored Stance
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_anchor.descr: Plant the hammer and hold the line: resistance and strength.
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_quake.name: Quake Strike
skill.soulland.blood_lash_cut.name: First Cut
skill.soulland.blood_lash_cut.descriptio: The lash opens a thin line and lets the blood do the work.
skill.soulland.blood_lash_drain.name: Sucking Wound
skill.soulland.blood_lash_drain.descript: The cord drinks what spills and passes it into your arm.
skill.soulland.blood_lash_crack.name: Crack of the Lash
skill.soulland.blood_lash_crack.descript: A single crack crosses the field and bruises everything it passes.
skill.soulland.blood_lash_rite.name: Rite of the Cord
skill.soulland.blood_lash_rite.descripti: The lash unspools and lashes out from every direction at once.
skill.soulland.frost_needle_prick.descri: One needle, one target, one line of frost spreading outward.
skill.soulland.frost_needle_spread.name: Spreading Frost
skill.soulland.frost_needle_spread.descr: The cold walks out from the needle and numbs the whole area.
skill.soulland.frost_needle_venom.name: Numbing Toxin
skill.soulland.frost_needle_storm.name: Needle Storm
skill.soulland.frost_needle_storm.descri: A hundred needles fill the air and fall like hail.
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_jab.name: Static Jab
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_jab.descrip: A short thrust leaves the target ringing.
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_sweep.name: Arc Sweep
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_sweep.descr: A wide arc of current passes through everything in front of you.
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_chain.name: Forked Current
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_chain.descr: The current forks into three enemies and leaves them convulsing.
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_storm.name: Stormhead
skill.soulland.thunder_spear_storm.descr: A thunderhead opens above you and drops into the field.
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_cut.name: Plain Cut
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_cut.descript: A clean cut, nothing more, nothing less.
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_guard.name: Guard Step
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_guard.descri: The sword comes up: resistance and a measured breath.
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_riposte.name: Riposte
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_riposte.desc: Wait for the enemy to come to you, then answer.
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_finish.name: Last Word
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_drop.name: Drop Anchor
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_drop.descript: The anchor falls on one enemy and pins it in place.
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_hold.name: Hold Fast
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_hold.descript: Everything in reach is dragged toward your hook.
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_swing.name: Anchor Swing
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_swing.descrip: A wide swing at the end of a chain catches the whole line.
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_moor.name: Moor the Fleet
skill.soulland.iron_anchor_moor.descript: The chain whips out in every direction and holds the field fast.
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_gleam.name: Gleam
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_gleam.descr: A flash of bronze light dazzles one enemy.
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_ward.name: Bronze Ward
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_ward.descri: The mirror turns the light aside: resistance for everyone nearby.
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_show.name: Show the Truth
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_show.descri: Every enemy in reach sees itself and loses the will to fight.
skill.soulland.bsemp_roots.name: Imperial Roots
skill.soulland.bsemp_roots.description: Deep roots take hold: resistance and a slow recovery.
skill.soulland.bsemp_tide.description: The field floods with blue silver and slows everything in it.
skill.soulland.bsemp_regrowth.name: Regrowth
skill.soulland.bsemp_regrowth.descriptio: Tissue knits itself back together and carries the whole line.
skill.soulland.bsemp_crown.name: Crown of Grass
skill.soulland.iron_body_set.name: Set the Bones
skill.soulland.iron_body_set.description: Lock the frame: resistance and a skin of cold iron.
skill.soulland.iron_body_brace.name: Braced Line
skill.soulland.iron_body_toll.name: Bell Toll
skill.soulland.iron_body_toll.descriptio: The whole body rings like a bell, and the field rings with it.
skill.soulland.bone_shell_grow.name: Shell Growth
skill.soulland.bone_shell_grow.descripti: New bone plates over old ones: resistance and a hard skin.
skill.soulland.bone_shell_spear.name: Bone Spear
skill.soulland.bone_shell_spear.descript: A splinter of bone leaves the shell and finds a soft place.
skill.soulland.bone_shell_bind.name: Bone Cage
skill.soulland.bone_shell_bind.descripti: The cage closes: enemies are caught and held in place.
skill.soulland.bone_shell_burst.name: Shell Burst
skill.soulland.bone_shell_burst.descript: The shell breaks outward and the fragments find every enemy.
skill.soulland.stone_skin_harden.name: Harden
skill.soulland.stone_skin_harden.descrip: The skin turns to stone for a short while.
skill.soulland.stone_skin_slam.name: Stone Fist
skill.soulland.stone_skin_slam.descripti: A heavy fist that does not care much about the target.
skill.soulland.stone_skin_sink.name: Sink
skill.soulland.stone_skin_sink.descripti: The ground opens and drags every enemy into it.
skill.soulland.stone_skin_quake.name: Quake
skill.soulland.stone_skin_quake.descript: The stone body strikes the ground and the plain answers.
skill.soulland.regrowth_close.name: Close
skill.soulland.regrowth_close.descriptio: The wound closes and the blood comes back.
skill.soulland.regrowth_bloom.name: Bloom
skill.soulland.regrowth_bloom.descriptio: Fresh tissue spreads outward and mends everyone nearby.
skill.soulland.regrowth_thorn.name: Thorn Skin
skill.soulland.regrowth_thorn.descriptio: The new skin grows thorns and the next hit draws blood.
skill.soulland.regrowth_rebirth.name: Rebirth Bloom
skill.soulland.flame_body_ignite.name: Ignite
skill.soulland.flame_body_ignite.descrip: The body flares and throws the enemy back.
skill.soulland.flame_body_walk.name: Walk on Fire
skill.soulland.flame_body_walk.descripti: Fire runs along the ground and burns everything it crosses.
skill.soulland.flame_body_ward.name: Ash Ward
skill.soulland.flame_body_ward.descripti: The flame banks down into ash armor: resistance and a burning edge.
skill.soulland.flame_body_pillar.name: Pillar of Fire
skill.soulland.flame_body_pillar.descrip: A column of fire stands in the middle of the field.
skill.soulland.veins_surge.name: Surge
skill.soulland.veins_surge.description: Spirit power jumps the gap between veins and the step quickens.
skill.soulland.veins_dash.name: Vein Dash
skill.soulland.veins_dash.description: A blink down the line of veins: two steps in one.
skill.soulland.veins_spark.name: Spark
skill.soulland.veins_spark.description: Static runs down the arms and into the nearest enemy.
skill.soulland.veins_circuit.name: Closed Circuit
skill.soulland.veins_circuit.description: Every vein in the field lights up at once.
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_show.name: Show the Soul
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_show.descript: The mirror shows the enemy its own shape, and the enemy falters.
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_drain.name: Drain the Image
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_refuse.name: Refuse the Gaze
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_refuse.descri: Every enemy that looks at the mirror is held in place.
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_shatter.name: Shatter the Image
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_shatter.descr: The mirror breaks into a thousand reflections and every one cuts.
skill.soulland.lamp_wick.name: Light the Wick
skill.soulland.lamp_aura.name: Lamp Circle
skill.soulland.lamp_aura.description: Light settles over the whole line and steadies it.
skill.soulland.lamp_mend.name: Mend by Lamplight
skill.soulland.lamp_mend.description: The lamp burns away what ails everyone nearby.
skill.soulland.lamp_douse.name: Douse the Field
skill.soulland.forge_strike.description: A single stroke of the hammer, still hot enough to bite.
skill.soulland.forge_heat.description: The forge glows white and the whole line hardens with it.
skill.soulland.forge_temper.description: Quench the target: damage and a marked weakness that lasts.
skill.soulland.forge_bellows.name: Bellows Blast
skill.soulland.forge_bellows.description: The bellows breathe and the fire rolls over the whole field.
skill.soulland.star_first_point.name: First Point
skill.soulland.star_first_point.descript: One point of the array ignites and falls on a single target.
skill.soulland.star_binding.name: Binding Array
skill.soulland.star_binding.description: The array folds space and holds every enemy inside it.
skill.soulland.star_chain.name: Constellation
skill.soulland.star_chain.description: Light runs from star to star and strikes three enemies in turn.
skill.soulland.star_collapse.name: Collapse
skill.soulland.star_collapse.description: The array folds onto itself and the field goes white.
skill.soulland.demon_eye_stare.name: Stare
skill.soulland.demon_eye_stare.descripti: One look is enough to make a target hesitate.
skill.soulland.demon_eye_drain.name: Draw the Spirit
skill.soulland.demon_eye_drain.descripti: The eye pulls at the target's spirit and the pull reaches you.
skill.soulland.demon_eye_hex.name: Hex
skill.soulland.demon_eye_hex.description: A curse settles on everyone who looked too long.
skill.soulland.demon_eye_open.name: The Eye Opens
skill.soulland.demon_eye_open.descriptio: The eye opens fully and the field is seen through it.
skill.soulland.seal_stamp.name: First Seal
skill.soulland.seal_stamp.description: The seal presses down on one target and leaves its mark.
skill.soulland.seal_bond.name: Sealed Bond
skill.soulland.seal_bond.description: The seal ties the whole line together against harm.
skill.soulland.seal_ward.name: Sealed Ward
skill.soulland.seal_ward.description: Old wards answer the call and the field turns aside the next blow.
skill.soulland.seal_unbroken.name: Unbroken Seal
skill.soulland.seal_unbroken.description: The seal breaks open and the whole array fires at once.
message.soulland.affinity.resonant: Affinity resonates: damage +20% against your target.
message.soulland.affinity.discordant: Affinity clashes: damage -15% against your target.
soul.soulland.seven_kill_sword.descripti: A sword that counts the dead and is never satisfied with the number.
soul.soulland.spirit_sword.description: A plain sword that keeps its own counsel and fights on its own terms.
soul.soulland.bronze_mirror.description: A mirror that shows the sect's enemies their own worst moment.
soul.soulland.spirit_veins.description: Spirit power runs under the skin instead of inside the chest, and the body moves like it.
soul.soulland.soul_mirror.description: A mirror that shows the shape of a soul, and does not care what it shows.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_frost.descript: Frozen claws split the target and leave it brittle.
skill.soulland.fire_dragon_scale.name: Molten Hide
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_veil.descripti: Your body hardens into frost: resistance and a thin layer of ice armor.
skill.soulland.ice_dragon_shatter.descri: A single frozen note shatters the will of every enemy nearby.
A wide charge flattens everything around you and knocks it back.
skill.soulland.thunder_elephant_charge.d: Charge up and slam: a heavy hit that leaves the target stunned.
skill.soulland.golden_ant_bite.name: Mandible Bite
skill.soulland.giant_ape_roar.name: War Roar
skill.soulland.moth_wingbeat.description: Wings beat the air into a gale that pushes enemies back.
skill.soulland.phoenix_ember.description: A short dive ends in a peck of fire.
skill.soulland.phoenix_talon.description: The phoenix drops from above and rakes three enemies at once.
skill.soulland.bss_pierce.name: Silver Thrust
skill.soulland.giant_hammer_quake.descri: The hammer meets the ground and the shock wave rolls outward.
skill.soulland.frost_needle_prick.name: Cold Pin
skill.soulland.frost_needle_venom.descri: Frostbite and poison together: the target stops healing.
skill.soulland.spirit_sword_finish.descr: One decisive stroke, taken at the moment the guard drops.
skill.soulland.bronze_mirror_reflect.des: The mirror throws back everything the field throws at you.
skill.soulland.bsemp_crown.description: A crown of blue silver rises and falls over the field.
skill.soulland.iron_body_ram.name: Ram
skill.soulland.iron_body_ram.description: Shoulder first: a heavy blow to a single target.
skill.soulland.iron_body_brace.descripti: Everyone nearby squares up and holds the line together.
skill.soulland.regrowth_rebirth.descript: A field of red flowers opens and closes over the battle.
skill.soulland.soul_mirror_drain.descrip: The mirror drinks what the enemy shows and passes it on.
skill.soulland.lamp_wick.description: A steady light warms one target and takes the edge off it.
skill.soulland.lamp_douse.description: The lamp gutters and the light swallows every enemy in sight.
skill.soulland.forge_strike.name: Hammer Out
skill.soulland.forge_heat.name: Heat the Stock
skill.soulland.forge_temper.name: Temper
soul.soulland.phoenix.name: Phoenix
skill.soulland.seven_kill_finish.descrip: The seventh stroke falls on the weakest of them and ends it.
skill.soulland.bsemp_tide.name: Green Tide
soul.soulland.truebody.hoe.name: Furrow Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.hoe.description: The plain tool turns into the authority of every furrow it opens.
soul.soulland.truebody.blue_silver_grass: Ten thousand years of grass learn to stand like a ruler.
soul.soulland.truebody.hell_civet.name: Nine Lives Shade
soul.soulland.truebody.hell_civet.descri: Nine lives folded into one shadow that strikes without a sound.
soul.soulland.truebody.sausage.name: Feast Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.sausage.descripti: A feast judge rules the table and decides who leaves hungry.
soul.soulland.truebody.seven_treasure_pa: Seven floors of blessing lift every ally who stands close enough.
soul.soulland.truebody.evil_fire_phoenix: The fire that never dies climbs higher with every life it burns.
soul.soulland.truebody.white_tiger.name: Snowfield Tiger Form
soul.soulland.truebody.white_tiger.descr: A tiger of the snow plains, where every paw print is a claim.
The bones go soft and the body becomes too fast to follow.
soul.soulland.truebody.jade_serpent.name: Jade Venom Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.jade_serpent.desc: The venom that once slowed a wound now slows an army.
The sky clears, and the hammer that falls leaves nothing standing.
soul.soulland.truebody.golden_dragon.des: The wyrm sheds its old scales and wears the sun instead.
soul.soulland.truebody.abyssal_demon_dra: Starless light clings to the dragon like a second set of scales.
soul.soulland.truebody.abyssal_ice_demon: The cold of the demon stops being cold and starts being silence.
soul.soulland.truebody.ultimate_fire_dra: A thousand years of volcano taught this dragon to wait, then to erupt.
soul.soulland.truebody.ultimate_ice_drag: The last glacier's dragon wakes slowly and never forgives being woken.
The herd runs with you, and the sky answers every step.
soul.soulland.truebody.golden_ant.name: Hollow Hill Form
soul.soulland.truebody.golden_ant.descri: What looked like a worker ant turns out to be the hill itself.
soul.soulland.truebody.titan_giant_ape.d: The ape stops hiding its size and starts using it.
soul.soulland.truebody.sea_devil_manatee: The slow shape under the water finally shows how deep it goes.
A thousand wings scatter the light until nothing can look at you.
soul.soulland.truebody.phoenix.name: Reignited Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.phoenix.descripti: The bird that burned comes back older, and quieter, and brighter.
soul.soulland.truebody.blue_silver_spear: The spear that grew from grass now points where the emperor points.
The sword stops counting the dead and starts counting the gods.
soul.soulland.truebody.giant_hammer.name: Anvil Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.giant_hammer.desc: The hammer that outgrew its smith now answers to the mountain.
soul.soulland.truebody.blood_lash.name: Cord of Ends Form
soul.soulland.truebody.blood_lash.descri: The cord stops opening wounds and starts deciding who closes them.
soul.soulland.truebody.frost_needle.name: Winter Needle Form
soul.soulland.truebody.frost_needle.desc: The needle that hides inside a body now hides inside the fight.
soul.soulland.truebody.thunder_spear.des: The spear is only visible when the lightning inside it is.
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_sword.name: Quiet Blade Form
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_sword.desc: The plain blade stops asking permission and answers on its own.
soul.soulland.truebody.iron_anchor.name: Drowned Anchor Form
soul.soulland.truebody.iron_anchor.descr: The anchor that never came up finally finds the bottom it was made for.
soul.soulland.truebody.bronze_mirror.des: The mirror turns its face outward and shows the sect its worst moment.
soul.soulland.truebody.blue_silver_emper: The grass grows old enough to rule, and rules without raising its voice.
soul.soulland.truebody.iron_body.name: Ironclad Form
soul.soulland.truebody.iron_body.descrip: The body that learned to be metal stops pretending it was ever flesh.
soul.soulland.truebody.bone_shell.name: Carapace Sovereign
soul.soulland.truebody.bone_shell.descri: The shell closes over the body like a decision that cannot be taken back.
soul.soulland.truebody.stone_skin.name: Bedrock Form
soul.soulland.truebody.stone_skin.descri: Ten years of rain teach the skin to answer blows with weight.
soul.soulland.truebody.flesh_regrowth.de: The wound closes faster than it should, and the body forgets the reason.
soul.soulland.truebody.flame_body.name: Ashen Form
soul.soulland.truebody.flame_body.descri: The fire inside answers every heat sent at it with more heat.
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_veins.name: Closed Circuit Form
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_veins.desc: Power stops running through the chest and starts running through the whole body.
soul.soulland.truebody.soul_mirror.name: Shattered Image Form
soul.soulland.truebody.soul_mirror.descr: The mirror breaks into a thousand pieces and every piece still shows the truth.
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_lamp.name: Everlight Form
soul.soulland.truebody.spirit_lamp.descr: The lamp that burns without oil finally lights the thought it was made for.
soul.soulland.truebody.soul_forge.name: Tempered Soul Form
soul.soulland.truebody.soul_forge.descri: The forge that shapes souls finally gets to shape the one that holds it.
soul.soulland.truebody.star_array.name: Collapsed Array Form
soul.soulland.truebody.star_array.descri: Seven points of light fold the field into the shape the array wants.
soul.soulland.truebody.demon_eye.name: Open Eye Form
soul.soulland.truebody.demon_eye.descrip: The eye opens wide enough to take in the whole field at once.
soul.soulland.truebody.ancient_seal.name: Unbroken Seal Form
soul.soulland.truebody.ancient_seal.desc: The seal answers the hand that made it, and the field obeys the seal.
soul.soulland.domain.hoe.name: Harvest Field
soul.soulland.domain.hoe.description: Nothing grows faster in a field that has already been ploughed.
soul.soulland.domain.blue_silver_grass.d: Blue silver floods the ground and holds every footstep inside it.
soul.soulland.domain.hell_civet.name: Shadow Domain
soul.soulland.domain.hell_civet.descript: Inside the shadow nothing can see you, and nothing can hide.
soul.soulland.domain.sausage.name: Banquet Domain
soul.soulland.domain.sausage.description: A table set for everyone, and a hunger that follows everyone out.
soul.soulland.domain.seven_treasure_pago: A golden roof over the field: allies burn brighter, enemies see less.
soul.soulland.domain.evil_fire_phoenix.d: Cinders on the ground: the field itself starts to burn.
soul.soulland.domain.white_tiger.name: Snowfield Domain
soul.soulland.domain.white_tiger.descrip: Snow covers the field and every step in it slows down.
soul.soulland.domain.soft_bone_rabbit.de: A field of mirages: you hit what you see and miss what is real.
soul.soulland.domain.jade_serpent.name: Venom Marsh Domain
soul.soulland.domain.jade_serpent.descri: The marsh water carries poison into every wound it touches.
soul.soulland.domain.clear_sky_hammer.de: A field of open sky: allies strike harder, enemies lose their footing.
soul.soulland.domain.golden_dragon.name: Molten Dominion
soul.soulland.domain.golden_dragon.descr: Molten ground that burns the resolve of allies and the footing of enemies.
soul.soulland.domain.abyssal_demon_drago: A field without stars: allies vanish, enemies lose their way.
soul.soulland.domain.abyssal_ice_demon_d: Frost holds the ground so steady that nothing in it can move.
soul.soulland.domain.ultimate_fire_drago: The ground opens like a caldera and burns everything around the rim.
soul.soulland.domain.ultimate_ice_dragon: A winter that does not end while the domain stands.
soul.soulland.domain.thunder_elephant.de: A storm without a shelter: allies move fast, enemies stand still.
soul.soulland.domain.golden_ant.name: Swarm Tunnel Domain
soul.soulland.domain.golden_ant.descript: Tunnels open under the field and the ground swallows the enemy's step.
soul.soulland.domain.titan_giant_ape.des: The plain itself answers the ape's fist and keeps shaking.
soul.soulland.domain.sea_devil_manatee.d: The water under the field pulls every enemy toward the centre.
soul.soulland.domain.bright_wing_moth.de: The air fills with light that blinds, and no one can find you in it.
soul.soulland.domain.phoenix.name: Reignition Domain
soul.soulland.domain.phoenix.description: The field keeps the ashes warm, so the next fire starts faster.
soul.soulland.domain.blue_silver_spear.d: A tide of grass rises through the field and drags the fight down to the ground.
soul.soulland.domain.seven_kill_sword.de: Seven marks on the field: whatever is marked here can be finished.
soul.soulland.domain.giant_hammer.name: Anvil Domain
soul.soulland.domain.giant_hammer.descri: An anvil field: allies stand firm, enemies are pinned to the ground.
soul.soulland.domain.blood_lash.name: Blood Ledger Domain
soul.soulland.domain.blood_lash.descript: A ledger opens in the field: allies get sharper, enemies get marked.
soul.soulland.domain.frost_needle.name: Numbing Domain
soul.soulland.domain.frost_needle.descri: The cold walks through the field and numbers every step it touches.
soul.soulland.domain.thunder_spear.name: Forked Current Domain
soul.soulland.domain.thunder_spear.descr: Forked lightning runs under the field and chooses who it reaches.
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_sword.name: Still Point Domain
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_sword.descri: A still point in the middle of the fight, where nothing else can move.
soul.soulland.domain.iron_anchor.name: Mooring Domain
soul.soulland.domain.iron_anchor.descrip: The field holds fast: allies do not move, enemies cannot leave.
soul.soulland.domain.bronze_mirror.name: Reflected Field Domain
soul.soulland.domain.bronze_mirror.descr: Everything thrown at the field is thrown back at whoever threw it.
soul.soulland.domain.blue_silver_emperor: A crown of grass closes over the field and decides what grows and what does not.
soul.soulland.domain.iron_body.name: Bell Toll Domain
soul.soulland.domain.iron_body.descripti: A bell tolls in the field and everyone nearby braces for it.
soul.soulland.domain.bone_shell.name: Bone Cage Domain
soul.soulland.domain.bone_shell.descript: The field grows a cage and every enemy in it learns the bars.
soul.soulland.domain.stone_skin.name: Sinkhole Domain
soul.soulland.domain.stone_skin.descript: The ground opens under the field and keeps whatever falls in.
soul.soulland.domain.flesh_regrowth.name: Red Bloom Domain
soul.soulland.domain.flesh_regrowth.desc: The field grows a red harvest and takes a cut of everyone's health.
soul.soulland.domain.flame_body.name: Pillar Domain
soul.soulland.domain.flame_body.descript: A column of fire stands in the field and nobody crosses it unharmed.
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_veins.name: Circuit Domain
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_veins.descri: Every vein in the field lights up at once and the ground follows.
soul.soulland.domain.soul_mirror.name: Soul Mirror Domain
soul.soulland.domain.soul_mirror.descrip: The field becomes a mirror: what enters is shown back as it truly is.
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_lamp.name: Lamplight Domain
soul.soulland.domain.spirit_lamp.descrip: A circle of lamplight keeps the field visible and the dark at bay.
soul.soulland.domain.soul_forge.name: Forge Domain
soul.soulland.domain.soul_forge.descript: The field is heated like metal: allies are hardened, enemies are cracked.
soul.soulland.domain.star_array.name: Constellation Domain
soul.soulland.domain.star_array.descript: The stars above the field rearrange, and the field obeys.
soul.soulland.domain.demon_eye.name: Hex Domain
soul.soulland.domain.demon_eye.descripti: The field is watched, so nothing in it can move unseen.
soul.soulland.domain.ancient_seal.name: Ancient Seal Domain
soul.soulland.domain.ancient_seal.descri: The seal presses its mark into the field and nothing there moves freely.
gui.soulland.combat.truebody_rules: Needs 7 spirit rings. Active 20 seconds, cooldown 5 minutes.
gui.soulland.combat.domain_rules: The domain stands until spirit power runs out.

message.soulland.truebody.unknown: This martial soul has no True Body.

message.soulland.truebody.cooldown: True Body is still on cooldown for %s seconds.
message.soulland.truebody.need_energy: Not enough spirit power for a True Body. You need %s.

message.soulland.truebody.expired: True Body ended. The cooldown starts now.
message.soulland.domain.not_awakened: Finish the awakening ceremony before standing in a domain.
message.soulland.domain.unknown: This martial soul has no domain.
message.soulland.domain.need_energy: Not enough spirit power to hold a domain. You need %s.
message.soulland.domain.opened: Domain stands: %s. Spirit power drains %s per second.
message.soulland.domain.drained: Spirit power ran out, the domain closes itself.
